mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 2 THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 1 THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense FROM ledger_record r JOIN ledger_category c ON r.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.record_time >= #{start} AND r.record_time < #{end}

SELECT c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, c.type AS type, SUM(r.amount) AS amount FROM ledger_record r JOIN ledger_category c ON r.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.record_time >= #{start} AND r.record_time < #{end} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.type ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.record_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 2 THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 1 THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM ledger_record r JOIN ledger_category c ON r.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.record_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.record_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
